title: The Great Day of the Lord

questions.question: "For behold, the day is coming, burning like an oven, when all the arrogant and all evildoers will be...; the day that is coming shall set them ablaze, says the Lord of hosts, so that it will leave them neither root nor branch."
questions.explanation: Malachi 4:1 (ESV): "when all the arrogant and all evildoers will be stubble. The day that is coming shall set them ablaze, says the Lord of hosts,"

questions.question: "But for you who fear my name, the... shall rise with healing in its wings."
questions.explanation: Malachi 4:2 (ESV): "But for you who fear my name, the sun of righteousness shall rise with healing in its wings."

questions.question: "You shall go out leaping like... from the stall."
questions.explanation: Malachi 4:2 (ESV): "You shall go out leaping like calves from the stall."

questions.question: "And you shall tread down the wicked, for they will be... under the soles of your feet, on the day when I act, says the Lord of hosts."
questions.explanation: Malachi 4:3 (ESV): "And you shall tread down the wicked, for they will be ashes under the soles of your feet, on the day when I act, says the Lord of hosts."

questions.question: "Remember the law of my servant..., the statutes and rules that I commanded him at Horeb for all Israel."
questions.explanation: Malachi 4:4 (ESV): "Remember the law of my servant Moses, the statutes and rules that I commanded him at Horeb for all Israel."

questions.question: "Behold, I will send you... the prophet before the great and awesome day of the Lord comes."
questions.explanation: Malachi 4:5 (ESV): "Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the great and awesome day of the Lord comes."

questions.question: "And he will turn the hearts of fathers to their children and the hearts of children to their fathers, lest I come and strike the land with a decree of..."
questions.explanation: Malachi 4:6 (ESV): "lest I come and strike the land with a decree of utter destruction."

questions.question: What is the promised outcome for those who fear the Lord's name when the day comes?
options: They will be healed and go out leaping like calves
They will be taken to heaven
questions.correctAnswer: They will be healed and go out leaping like calves
questions.explanation: Malachi 4:2 (ESV): "the sun of righteousness shall rise with healing in its wings. You shall go out leaping like calves from the stall."

questions.question: Who will the arrogant and evildoers become like on the coming day?
questions.explanation: Malachi 4:1 (ESV): "when all the arrogant and all evildoers will be stubble."

questions.question: Where were the statutes and rules commanded to Moses for all Israel?
questions.explanation: Malachi 4:4 (ESV): "the statutes and rules that I commanded him at Horeb for all Israel."

questions.question: What will the day that is coming do to the arrogant and evildoers, leaving them neither root nor branch?
questions.explanation: Malachi 4:1 (ESV): "The day that is coming shall set them ablaze, says the Lord of hosts, so that it will leave them neither root nor branch."

questions.question: What kind of wings will the sun of righteousness rise with?
questions.explanation: Malachi 4:2 (ESV): "the sun of righteousness shall rise with healing in its wings."

questions.question: Elijah the prophet is to be sent before what comes?
options: The great and awesome day of the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: The great and awesome day of the Lord
questions.explanation: Malachi 4:5 (ESV): "before the great and awesome day of the Lord comes."

questions.question: What will the people who fear the Lord's name do to the wicked?
options: Drive them out of the land
questions.explanation: Malachi 4:3 (ESV): "And you shall tread down the wicked,"

questions.question: What is the very last word of the Old Testament in English translations (like the ESV) based on the Hebrew text?
questions.explanation: Malachi 4:6 (ESV): "lest I come and strike the land with a decree of utter destruction." (Some translations say 'curse').

key_verse_text: "Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the great and awesome day of the Lord comes. And he will turn the hearts of fathers to their children and the hearts of children to their fathers, lest I come and strike the land with a decree of utter destruction."
